entries.headline: French suspicion of Iranian cyberattack involvement relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel said Al Jazeera Arabic reported, 47 minutes before later wire coverage, that Reuters, citing sources, reported French officials suspected Iran was behind cyberattacks. The visible quoted text is truncated after “cyberattacks…”, so no targets or further detail are stated. The account said three outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. cargo and surveillance aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large U.S. military cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside a signals-intelligence aircraft and a naval surveillance drone. The visible source text is truncated after saying Gulf-region air activity “remains…”, so no further level or comparison is stated.

entries.headline: U.S. strikes on Iranian military systems relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Reuters report that U.S. strikes targeted Iran's radar, missile and mine-laying systems. The post credited Ian3130.

entries.headline: Strikes on Ukraine's power grid reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported strikes on Ukraine's power grid as peace talks approached. The post credited Ian3130.

entries.headline: TEAM31 KC-46A Pegasus sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported TEAM31, identified as a Boeing KC-46A Pegasus with registration 19-46064 and hex code AE5FAB. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: BLKCAT5 MQ-4C Triton movement reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported BLKCAT5, identified as an MQ-4C Triton with registration 169602 and hex code AE7811, leaving Naval Station Mayport. The sighting was credited to JessiDavin.

entries.headline: Russian defence jet arrival in Israel relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Jerusalem Post report that a sanctioned Russian Defence Ministry jet landed in Israel after departing a Moscow military base. The post credited reagan0965.

entries.headline: Heavy U.S. airlift and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported heavy airlift activity over the United States, with multiple large transport aircraft airborne, and said six coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts had been heard earlier in the day, the latest at 05:13 Zulu.

entries.headline: Trump comments on Iran conflict relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a statement attributed to Donald Trump that he saw no reason to escalate the war with Iran and was focused on his long-term goals in the conflict. The post credited Ian3130.

entries.headline: Leaked Qatari-mediated proposal reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a C14 English report that Iranian journalists had leaked a Qatari-mediated proposal showing potential terms for a diplomatic breakthrough. The visible source text is truncated after “to…”, so no parties or further outcome are stated. The post credited jackhoricon.

entries.headline: U.S. Air Force transport and Black Sea activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across the Pacific and over the United States, Black Sea air activity at nearly 2.6 times normal, and six coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts. The visible source text is truncated after “broadcasts…”, so no further detail is stated.

entries.headline: Reported strike on Ukrainian disability centre relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel said Kyiv Post reported, 36 minutes before later wire coverage, that a Russian drone strike destroyed a specialised centre for children with disabilities in Ukraine. The visible quoted text is truncated after “Ukraine’s…”, so no city or further detail is stated. The account said two outlets later confirmed the report.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NASA806 U-2 movement reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported NASA806, described as a U-2, at about 60,000 feet and heading eastward.

entries.headline: Business-jet activity and growth leaders reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that over the 13 weeks to 1 November, the Phenom 300 accounted for 9.4% of tracked business-jet activity, the Latitude 7.1% and the XLS 6.1%. Among aircraft types with at least a 1% share, it said the G650 grew 17.3% and the Falcon 2000 grew 15.8% when comparing the latest four weeks with the first four, while activity across all types rose 8.0%.

entries.headline: SCORE90 Global Hawk sighting reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracking SCORE90, a Northrop Grumman Global Hawk (Q4), off the Mid-Atlantic coast. It said the aircraft was spotted at about 49,900 feet at 2:44 p.m. ET on 3 November and last seen around 3:01 p.m. about nine miles east-southeast of Ocean City, Maryland.

entries.headline: NTSB weather focus in Sunday crash relayed
entries.summary: SkyGlass relayed comments from its founder about air-traffic-control audio from Sunday's crash and said the audio would not be shared out of respect. It reported that the NTSB was focusing on weather and offered condolences to those affected.

entries.headline: NetJets and Flexjet activity growth reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracked NetJets and Flexjet activity up 11.0% in October 2026 from October 2025, while full-service Jet A rose from $7.50 to $7.86. It said fractional flying did not slow and that the figures were pulled with the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: N722BD Learjet 60 crash reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Learjet 60 N722BD, flying from Austin to North Eleuthera, crashed near Military Trail in Palm Beach County on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people aboard. It said the NTSB was investigating and shared an AVIAR Labs Overwatch replay.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.
